$comment: What Mark is up to right now (nownownow.com style). Rendered by the `now` command and the SSR content. Update `updated` whenever the list changes. Never add anything here that reads as job-seeking: this site must not suggest Mark is open to roles.
items: Work: FY27 planning at Onshape, and the next round of AI tooling across the company.
Building an agent-readable memory of my own systems and preferences (an "AI context dictionary"), so the agents that run my homelab, grocery orders and security sweeps start with real context.
RigReady 2.0, rebuilt from a requirements ledger with parallel Claude Code agents. Working toward a first public release.
Homelab hardening: Dependency-Track fed by nightly SBOM scans, a weekly security sweep, pinned image digests.
Outside: solo backpacking on the Appalachian Trail sections near home, and a 1991 Honda Acty kei truck that always needs something.
